exact.Lance Claude Code, Codex ou Gemini CLI d: Launch Claude Code, Codex or Gemini CLI in one of your projects with one click. A board shows running sessions; “Go there” brings the right window to the front. Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI notify the island: “waiting for your permission”, “finished”. They go through the “ondine.exe notify” command and a local channel reserved for your Windows account: nothing goes over the Internet. Hooked up as an MCP server, the island also lets the agent send you a message, a progress update, start the timer or ask you a multiple-choice question. Focus mode holds their notifications and gives you a summary at the end. If you enable it (off by default), you can also allow or deny an action from Claude Code or Codex from the island, after confirmation. The island never runs anything, never decides for you, and reads neither what you type nor the AI's replies.

patterns: ^Autoriser\ /\ Refuser\ depuis\ l'île\ \((.+?)\)\ :\ quand\ (.+?)\ demande\ une\ permission,\ l'île\ montre\ la\ commande\ avec\ «\ Autoriser\ »\ \(à\ confirmer\)\ et\ «\ Refuser\ »\.\ Sans\ réponse\ à\ temps,\ la\ question\ passe\ au\ terminal\.\ Colle\ ce\ hook\ en\ plus,\ de\ la\ même\ façon\.$

Allow / Deny from the island ($1): when $2 asks for a permission, the island shows the command with "Allow" (to confirm) and "Deny". If there's no reply in time, the question falls back to the terminal. Paste this hook in addition, the same way.
^(.+?)\ est\ sur\ un\ lecteur\ sans\ Corbeille\ \(clé\ USB,\ réseau…\)\ :\ l'île\ ne\ supprime\ jamais\ définitivement,\ fais\-le\ toi\-même\ si\ tu\ es\ sûr$
$1 is on a drive without a Recycle Bin (USB stick, network…): the island never deletes permanently, do it yourself if you're sure
^«\ \.(.+?)\ »\ n'est\ pas\ pris\ en\ charge\ :\ un\ fichier\ texte\ \(\.txt,\ \.log,\ code…\)\ ou\ une\ image\ \(\.png,\ \.jpg\)$
“.$1” is not supported: use a text file (.txt, .log, code…) or an image (.png, .jpg)
^(.+?)\ est\ déjà\ utilisé\ par\ un\ autre\ logiciel\ :\ choisis\ un\ autre\ raccourci\ dans\ les\ réglages\ du\ Lanceur$
$1 is already used by another program: pick another shortcut in the Launcher settings
^(.+?)\ est\ déjà\ pris\ par\ un\ autre\ logiciel\ :\ choisis\ un\ autre\ raccourci\ dans\ les\ réglages\ de\ Contrôles$
$1 is already taken by another program: pick another shortcut in the Controls settings
^(.+?)\ a\ été\ mis\ à\ l'écart\ après\ trois\ plantages\.\ Il\ revient\ au\ prochain\ démarrage\ de\ l'appli\.$
$1 was sidelined after three crashes. It will return at the app's next launch.
^(.+?)\ est\ déjà\ pris\ par\ un\ autre\ logiciel\ :\ choisis\ un\ autre\ raccourci\ dans\ Réglages\ >\ Général$
$1 is already taken by another program: pick another shortcut in Settings > General
^⏳\ Pas\ de\ réponse\ de\ (.+?)\ sur\ le\ port\ (.+?)\ :\ serveur\ éteint,\ ou\ un\ pare\-feu\ bloque$
⏳ No response from $1 on port $2: server is off, or a firewall is blocking
^Colle\-le\ dans\ (.+?),\ puis\ active\ le\ réglage\ «\ Autoriser\ /\ Refuser\ depuis\ l'île\ »\.$
Paste it into $1, then turn on the "Allow / Deny from the island" setting.
^Règle\ «\ (.+?)\ »\ supprimée\ \(«\ Annuler\ »\ dans\ l'île\ pendant\ quelques\ secondes\)\.$
Rule “$1” deleted (“Undo” in the island for a few seconds).
^le\ serveur\ refuse\ cette\ adresse\ \(code\ (.+?)\)\ :\ recopie\ l'adresse\ secrète\ iCal$
the server refuses this address (code $1): copy the secret iCal address again
^(.+?)\ minutes\ d'écran\ :\ lève\-toi,\ regarde\ au\ loin,\ bois\ un\ verre\ d'eau\.$
$1 minutes of screen time: stand up, look into the distance, drink a glass of water.
unable to move: $1 (incomplete copy left in $2)
^⛔\ Port\ (.+?)\ fermé\ :\ (.+?)\ répond,\ mais\ rien\ n'écoute\ sur\ ce\ port$
⛔ Port $1 closed: $2 responds, but nothing is listening on this port
^(.+?)\ ne\ remplit\ pas\ les\ conditions\ :\ la\ règle\ ne\ ferait\ rien\.$
$1 does not meet the conditions: the rule would do nothing.
^copié,\ mais\ l'original\ n'a\ pas\ pu\ aller\ à\ la\ Corbeille\ :\ (.+?)$
copied, but the original could not be sent to the Recycle Bin: $1
^(.+?)\ :\ pas\ une\ image\ lisible\ \(PNG,\ JPEG,\ WebP,\ BMP\ ou\ GIF\)$
$1: not a readable image (PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP or GIF)
^le\ module\ (.+?)\ a\ été\ mis\ à\ l'écart\ après\ plusieurs\ plantages$
module $1 was sidelined after several crashes

the Snipping Tool does not open (code $1)
^Plus\ que\ (.+?)\ %\ :\ pense\ à\ brancher\ le\ chargeur\.$
Only $1% left: remember to plug in the charger.
^Rien\ de\ prévu\ dans\ les\ (.+?)\ prochains\ jours\.\ 🌴$
Nothing planned in the next $1 days. 🌴
